title: Unknown native repair spend remains partial through chain and Ops measurements
steps: Exercise repair summaries, the real chain engine and Ops projection with unknown, mixed, zero and historical reported costs.
expect: Unknown native spend and total remain null, with the measured subtotal preserved separately.
A repair with no turns has zero native spend; historical measured numbers and genuine zero stay numeric.
Running snapshots preserve the same unknown and measured cost semantics.
The existing Ops amount formatter prints unavailable spend as an empty measurement marker, retaining genuine zero and measured cents.
fence: Never estimate pricing or rewrite historical measurements.

tests: unknown and mixed native turn costs stay unknown with their known subtotal
the real chain engine retains an explicitly unknown repair answer
Ops keeps a terminal partial subtotal without zero filling unknown write spend
unknown chain spend is not printed as a measured zero
